headline: Apple reports ex-employees may have leaked confidential data to OpenAI
body: Apple disclosed that additional former employees potentially transferred confidential company information to OpenAI, marking an escalation in data security concerns around AI talent mobility. This incident arrives alongside heightened regulatory scrutiny, including a letter from 15 state Attorneys General and ongoing investigations into autonomous AI hacks affecting firms like Hugging Face. For healthcare AI vendors and consultants, this signals that IP protection and employee data governance are becoming regulatory flashpoints. Healthcare organizations evaluating AI partnerships should now factor data security protocols and vendor compliance posture into vendor selection criteria, especially as talent flows between competitors intensify competitive pressures in clinical AI development.
